description: The www products page showed one hidden hero photo and no product pictures. Find the root cause, pin it with Playwright and unit tests that check what a reader sees at 390, 980, 1024, and 1280 px, and fix what is still wrong.
deviation_notes: The hero fix and the product pictures (8193625ca) were pushed before the Red phase, because the stop order reached the session after the push. Red proves each test's meaning by a failing run at 8193625ca^ (hero, product photos) and a failing run at HEAD for what is still wrong (the covered photo, the Tutor section without a picture).
